For a **15 lb baby**, I’d buy **Size 2** **if Wiggle & Snug Snug-Fit uses the common diaper weight ranges**: **Size 2 = 12–18 lb**, while **Size 3 typically starts around 16 lb**. ([bcbabycare.com](https://www.bcbabycare.com/products/cloud-skin-diaper?utm_source=openai))

Since 15 lb is near the upper-middle of Size 2, consider **Size 3** only if the baby is already getting red marks, frequent leaks/blowouts, or the tabs are hard to fasten comfortably. Otherwise, **Size 2 is the best starting choice**.
